title: Algebraic Lattices Arising from Congruence Submodules in Subfields of $p$-th Cyclotomic Fields
summary: The classical sphere packing problem, which remains unsolved, consists of determining how densely a large number of identical spheres can be packed together. In some sphere packings, the centers of the spheres in a sphere packing form a Euclidean lattice, which is a discrete additive subgroup of $\mathbb{R}^n$. Free $\mathbb{Z}$-modules in the ring of integers of an algebraic number field yield algebraic lattices via the canonical embedding.
